why_this_page: Has both headers and both main text columns on a spread.
Has Latin marginalia overlapping a Chinese main-text column.
Has a page number and ignorable modern footer.
Surface area is rich enough to expose boundary mistakes without being an extreme hard case.

expected_boxes.canonical_text:
天
為
民
立
君

notes: Right main text may contain the title line 仲虺之誥.
Right main text must not inherit the short header stack from r1.

expected_boxes.canonical_text:
天
賦
恒
性

notes: Left main text must not inherit the left header stack.
惺/恒 confusion at the boundary is a known failure mode.
This box can be messy Latin, but it should not retain Chinese spill from r2.

validators.name: header_spill_into_main
validators.description: Main text on the same side/column as a header must not start with short header-like spill lines.

validators.name: marginalia_script_contamination
validators.description: Latin marginalia must not retain Chinese spill from adjacent main text.

validators.name: page_number_noise
validators.description: Page-number boxes should collapse to trivial folio/page numerals only.

success_definition: r1 and r3 are short, clean headers only.
r2 and r4 begin with real body text, not header spill.
r5 is Latin-only or Latin-like with no Chinese spill.
r6 normalizes to just the page number.
Rendered folio shows one clean witness block per logical section without obvious duplication.
